title: Expose authenticated owner manual cash-note recording
requirements: Expose POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{id}/cash-notes solely as an adapter for OwnerCommandService.record_cash_note. Accept strict JSON expected_version, optional expected_visit_versions, kind RECEIPT|REFUND_NOTE, amount_minor, occurred_at and note; no corrections or payment integration.

Require valid owner session, exact Origin, application/json, matching X-CSRF-Token and Idempotency-Key before dispatch. Reuse the established no-store error boundary: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED, 403 FORBIDDEN or CSRF_FAILED, 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.

On first acceptance return 200 {data:{command_id,inquiry,changed_visits}}; accepted identical replay returns the same data and Idempotent-Replay:true. Reject strict-shape errors before consuming the key.
Map NOT_FOUND to 404; IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH and VERSION_CONFLICT to 409; RESULT_EXPIRED to 410; EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED and all cash input errors to 422 without diagnostics.

Add isolated synthetic PostgreSQL route tests for browser boundary, strict body, RECEIPT and REFUND_NOTE, planned/unplanned version rules, replay/mismatch/expiry, audit persistence and status invariance. Never read local .env or configured source database.
Do not modify core, add corrections, payment execution, webhooks, frontend, migrations, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can record factual receipt/refund notes through HTTP without changing service status.
Retries, versions and browser-state checks prevent duplicate or partial cash facts.
Focused tests, scope and whitespace pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow owner HTTP adapter over reviewed manual cash-note core.
